title: Gods Memorial: The Smoke of Her Torment

sense.text:
Today is Memorial Day, and we are going into the scriptures to show the wars America fought, starting with the war of independence. This is Bible history prophecy.

“A fourth beast, dreadful and terrible, and strong exceedingly”: this fourth beast is the Caucasian race, starting with Rome all the way here to America. “And it had ten horns”: the ten horns are the EU.

“There came up among them another little horn”: amongst those ten horns there came up another horn, and this is the horn to pay attention to. That horn is America.

“Before whom there were three of the first horns plucked up by the roots”: the three horns plucked up are France, Spain and Britain. America went to war with those three nations before America gained her independence, and America won. The last nation America went to war with was Britain, fighting Britain to get its independence.

“In this horn were eyes like the eyes of man”: they see everything. “And a mouth speaking great things”: the great things this horn speaks are the lies. The lie that the Jews are white, and America helped put the Jewish people in the land of Israel. The lie that God looked like him. The homosexual agenda he is pushing, and all the lies America is pushing on the earth today. Saying that we are not the Jews: these are the great words that he is speaking.

precepts.why:
“Come hither; I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great”: I’m going to show you what’s going to happen to that hoe. She “sitteth upon many waters”: the waters are the nations. “With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication”: all the kingdoms have committed fornication with this hoe. “And the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.”

This hoe we are reading about is America. America is that filthy nasty hoe; them nasty hoes you see walking up and down the street, that’s America. That is how the Most High looks at America: a filthy nasty hoe, decked out, she got on bad clothes, she rich. A rich hoe.

“I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”: this woman is that same hoe, and the scarlet coloured beast is a red beast, the same fourth beast we read in Daniel, Edom, the so-called Caucasian race. That hoe is sitting upon them, and she is that same horn we just read about in Daniel. She is “full of names of blasphemy,” and the beast she sits on has “seven heads and ten horns.”

“And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: the eighth is America, that hoe. “And is of the seven”: America came from Britain, and it means he fought the seventh head, Britain, in order to gain independence. That is the war of independence written right here.

Early in the chapter America is called a she, the hoe; further down she is called one of the heads, he that is the eighth. The eighth head is that woman that sitteth upon the seven heads. So there are not just seven heads: we have the original seven, then that horn, that hoe sitting upon the seven, which makes it eight.

“And goeth into perdition”: he is going into perdition, meaning destruction. John the Revelator wrote about this over two thousand years ago, and it came to pass in 1776.

sense.text: “Then I would know the truth of the fourth beast, which was diverse from all the others”: diverse means different from all the others. “Whose teeth were of iron, and his nails of brass”: this is going into his militaries.

“And before whom three fell”: that is Spain, France and Britain. “A mouth that spake very great things”: the very great things are the blasphemies and the lies that the white man has been teaching on the earth.

“Whose look was more stout than his fellows”: America is militarily stronger than all the other ten horns. He is stronger than France, stronger than Britain, stronger than Spain, stronger than his whole European allies. That is why they formed NATO, and America is the head of NATO.

All these inventions of mass destruction and murder were invented in America. The Gatling gun in 1861, the airplane, guns, the nuclear weapon: all invented in America.

“I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints”: that horn is America, and we are the saints. So when you celebrate Memorial Day, the wars of America and his fallen soldiers, you are celebrating the destruction of your own people.

Memorial Day honors the soldiers that died in the wars America fought. It was set up right after the Civil War, which began in 1861. From 1868 to 1970 Memorial Day was celebrated on May the 30th, and from 1970 they started celebrating it every last Monday in May. We are not supposed to be celebrating Memorial Day, because they went to war on us. It is not just in remembrance of the Vietnam War and World War II; it is also in remembrance of when they made war against us: against the North American Indians, against the tribe of Issachar. That is why on Esau’s wicked holidays we open the schools, so you can come and be amongst each other and go over the scriptures instead of being around all of that.

The wars America fought against our people: the war of independence in 1775. The American Indian war, or American frontier war, from 1609 to 1924, when America went to war with the natives of this land, the tribe of Gad, and murdered a lot of our brothers the North American Indians; that is how they were able to get this land. The Mexican American war, 1846 to 1848, when America took Texas from the so-called Mexicans, the tribe of Issachar; Texas once belonged to them.

All the lands of the United States, Washington DC, New York, Iowa, Louisiana, belonged to our brothers, the saints of God. Esau Edom came and made war with them and took the land from them. They set up colonies; the pilgrims came here and murdered the North American Indians and took the land. New Mexico, San Antonio, all that land was taken from the so-called Mexicans. Now when they come over here they say they are illegal immigrants, deport them, put up fences around the border, but this land once belonged to them, and the United States took it from them.

“And prevailed against them”: he prevailed against the saints of God, against us. These are the prophecies that they would conquer the North American Indians and the tribe of Gad and take the land from them. He made war with us with the sword, he killed us, and he prevailed; that is how he was able to establish the United States of America.

precepts.why:
Who are the saints? “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints”: his saints are his people. And who is his people? “Even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him.” Even means indeed: indeed the children of Israel. The saints of God are the children of Israel.

Don’t let nobody fool you with ‘when the saints go marching in, I want to be in that number.’ You got white people and Chinese singing when the saints come marching in, and it is not about them. That is talking about the slaves, the Negroes, the North American Indians, the Mexicans, the Puerto Ricans, the people that were enslaved and destroyed. God’s people: they are the saints.

This touches on the horn making war with us and overcoming us. Issachar is the so-called Mexican. “Issachar is a strong ass couching down between two burdens: And he saw that rest was good, and the land that it was pleasant”: the land is Texas, California, all of that belonged to Issachar. He saw the land was pleasant.

“And bowed his shoulder to bear”: for you to bow your shoulders to bear, you became a servant. Issachar became a servant, a slave. The so-called Mexicans were conquered and destroyed by the Conquistadors and by the Americans, by the pilgrims that came over here. He became a servant to America and a servant to the Conquistadors. How did Issachar become a servant? Today anywhere you go you see them on the streets selling all type of stuff; they are the ones working on the construction sites and in these farms, and they’re working for next to nothing.

“And became a servant unto tribute”: he was conquered by America, and America took the land from them. That is how they got California and Texas, in the Mexican American war of 1846 to 1848, when America took the land of Texas from Issachar, the so-called Mexicans.

“Gad, a troop shall overcome him.” What troop overcame the tribe of Gad? Gad is the so-called North American Indian. They were overcome through war by America, under the control of Andrew Jackson; he was at the head of it. The troop that overcame the tribe of Gad is the U.S. Cavalry troop led by Andrew Jackson.

This scripture is talking about the war between the North American Indians and America, and that war lasted all the way up to 1924. When they invented the Gatling gun, that gave them military supremacy; that is how they were able to conquer Gad, killing them out in the thousands.

So when you celebrate Memorial Day, the wars of America and the fallen soldiers of America, you are celebrating the destruction of your own people, because America made war with your people.

Some online might be saying, what is he talking about, Israelite North American Indians? “Those are the ten tribes, which were carried away prisoners out of their own land” by the king of Assyria, “and he carried them over the waters, and so came they into another land.”

“But they took this counsel among themselves, that they would leave the multitude of the heathen”: they would leave that side of the world where they were at, “and go forth into a further country, where never mankind dwelt.” Which part of this earth did mankind never dwell in for centuries? It is talking about the new world, what Christopher Columbus and them called the new world. Our forefathers came over here.

All the people that inhabited these lands, Puerto Rico, Florida, the whole of North America, South America and all these islands, all the people that inhabited the new world, were the ten tribes of Israel. So when Daniel says that horn made war with the saints, go to North America: these are the saints he made war with.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him. And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth.” The fourth part of the world is America, this side of the world: the United States, North America. That is the fourth part of the earth.

Power was given unto them, the so-called Americans, the white men, the pilgrims, over the fourth part of the earth, “to kill with sword.” This lets you know how they got the land over here: they killed the North American Indians, millions of them, with the sword. They didn’t come here in peace, and the North American Indians did not sell the land to no one for beads; don’t be listening to those lies of the so-called white man. “And with hunger, and with death, and with the beasts of the earth.”

So the same horn, America, made war with the Israelites and prevailed against us with the sword.

sense.text: “In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear”: when the Lord gives us rest, that is when Christ returns and delivers us up out of these lands where we were made slaves.

“This proverb against the king of Babylon”: the king of Babylon is America, that same horn. “How hath the oppressor ceased”: America is the oppressor, oppressing the children of Israel; that goes back to Daniel, where the horn made war with the saints.

“The golden city ceased”: this lets you know America is rich. That country where the slaves are is rich; America is the richest country on the planet earth, and that is why everybody wants to come to America.
“Thy pomp is brought down to the grave”: America is destroyed. “The worm is spread under thee, and the worms cover thee.”

“For thou hast said in thine heart”: America, the oppressor, said in his heart. “I will ascend into heaven”: this lets you know who invented the airplanes: America, the Wright brothers, in 1903. The so-called white man said he will ascend into heaven, and they built airplanes. “I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: this is going into space travel. Who were the first people to go to space? America. This is Bible prophecy. The book don’t lie.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: what congregation is America sitting on? It is what we read earlier, that the horn shall make war with the saints of the Most High and overcome them. It is America conquering the so-called Mexicans, the so-called North American Indians, the Seminole Indians, which is Reuben. In going to war with them she has conquered them, and she is sitting on them, meaning America, that horn, is ruling over them.

“In the sides of the north” is North America, the fourth part of the earth.

precepts.why:
“Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the Lord, that it shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt”, but the Lord liveth that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north.

The land of the north is what we just read in Isaiah 14: she shall sit upon the mount of the congregation in the sides of the north. The congregation is the Israelites in the land of the north. It will no longer be said the Lord delivered the children of Israel out of Egypt, but the Lord delivered the congregation from the land of the north, where America is sitting on us, where they enslaved us and took our land from us.

I say us because that land is my land too, damn it. America belonged to my brothers, the tribe of Gad, so that makes it mine too.

sense.text: Zechariah says the same thing. “Ho, ho, come forth, and flee from the land of the north, saith the Lord”: the land of the north is North America. “For I have spread you abroad as the four winds of the heaven.”

“Deliver thyself, O Zion”: Zion represents the twelve tribes of Israel, because the twelve tribes of Israel will be in the sides of the north. The ten tribes were over here already, and then Judah, Benjamin and Levi were brought here on cargo slave ships in the 1600s, through the transatlantic slave trade.

“That dwellest with the daughter of Babylon”: America is the daughter of Babylon, because the same thing ancient Babylon was doing is the same thing America is doing.

precepts.why: Judah, Benjamin and Levi were brought here to the sides of the north on cargo slave ships through the transatlantic slave trade, and you can read about that: “the Lord shall bring thee into Egypt again with ships.”

What scripture proves America is the daughter of Babylon? “Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof. O daughter of Babylon.” Edom is the so-called white man, the Caucasian race, and the Bible refers to Edom as the daughter of Babylon.

“Who art to be destroyed”: God is going to destroy America. A lot of you are living in this rich golden city and you’re comfortable, but God is going to destroy America, because that horn made war with the saints and prevailed against us.

sense.text:
God is gonna destroy America. I know a lot of you all is living in this rich, the golden city, and you’re comfortable, but God is gonna destroy America. Why? Go back to Daniel 7. “I beheld, and the same horn made war with the saints”: that horn made war with the Israelites, because America made war with us. “And prevailed against them”: prevailed against us, enslaved us, took the land from us.

So why the hell would we go and talk about we celebrate Memorial Day? Memorial Day, celebrating veterans of the wars America fought, is also about the wars that they fought against you.

“Until the Ancient of days came, and judgment was given to the saints of the most High”. The time is going to come when judgment is going to be given to those same slaves that you will be gunning down on the street, those same slaves you say are no good, those same slaves you don’t want to cross over the border. The scripture says judgment is going to be given unto them by God. God gave you judgment; we want judgment to be given unto us.

“And the time came that the saints possessed the kingdom.” If you keep the commandments you are one of the saints of God, and God is going to give you the kingdom. What is the kingdom? Not going up in the heavens. The kingdom is this whole planet Earth: the saints of God will possess it.

“Thus he said, The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth”: the fourth kingdom upon the earth is the Caucasian race. They are the fourth and the last beast. “Which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth”: the so-called white man have conquered the whole earth, “and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.”

“And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings”: the ten kings are Europe, the European Union. “And another shall rise after them”: the last kingdom to rise upon this earth was America. That’s that next kingdom that rose after them. “And he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings”.

“And he shall speak great words against the most High”: the great words he’s speaking are against God. “And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: how did he wear us out? By going to war with us. He went to war with us, enslaved us and took our land from us; he took North America. “And think to change times and laws”: and he have changed times and he have changed laws.

That was a little prophecy and a little history concerning Memorial Day.

precepts.why:
What is the kingdom the saints possess? Put it together. “And he that overcometh, and keepeth my works unto the end”: if you keep God’s works, meaning his commandments, to the end, meaning until you die or until Christ return. If you obey your mother and your father and don’t give them no problems, you’re being good, you’re keeping God’s commandments.

“To him will I give power over the nations”. That’s what Christ is going to give you if you do what’s right: power over the nations. See how today in society all nations is above the children of Israel. We’re living in the ghettos, in the slums; the Chinese, the East Indians, the Caucasian race, they all got power over us. But the time is gonna come where we will have power over them. Christ is going to give us power over them. We gonna be proud to call ourselves a Jew, proud to say we are the children of Israel, and no damn heathen could come and shut down your bank account and take away millions of dollars from you talking about you anti-semitic. That shows we don’t have that power now, but in that day the Lord said he’s going to give us power over the nations.

“And he shall rule them with a rod of iron”. When you get power over the nations you have power over everybody on the earth; the kingdom of heaven is you having power over everybody on the earth. What does a rod of iron mean? If anybody do things you don’t like, things against what God said to do, you gonna beat them. You ever get a whooping from your pops? The scripture talks a lot about correction: you do something wrong, you get whooped, because your father got power over you. Now you got power over everybody on this earth. “As the vessels of a potter shall they be broken to shivers”: you’re gonna beat them down, beat them to pieces. Today is a Sabbath; I don’t want no nations on the earth buying and selling. All nations gonna learn to obey and do what God said to do, and the ones who are going to enforce that are those of us that endure to the end.

So the kingdom of heaven is not going to live up in the sky. It’s not some make-believe bullcrap that the white men teach you. It’s not just that you’re gonna live forever: Christ says I’m gonna give you power over the nations. The kingdom of heaven is real, it’s gonna be on earth, and it’s about rulership.

sense.text: This is my new favorite scripture. “How long shall it be to the end of these wonders?” The end of these wonders is going into Israel being destroyed, us being conquered by the white man, us being led as slaves into the four corners of the earth. How long shall this be?

“And sware by him that liveth for ever that it shall be for a time, times, and an half”. A time, that’s a hundred years; times, that’s 200 years, that’s 300 years; and an half, that’s 350 years. Meaning we will be destroyed for over 350 years.

“And when he shall have accomplished to scatter the power of the holy people”: when we are scattered through the four corners of the earth as slaves, “all these things shall be finished.”
“And I heard, but I understood not: then said I, O my Lord, what shall be the end of these things?”

“Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed”. Daniel, go your way: this book is closed up and sealed, because some things Daniel wasn’t understanding. Remember, Christ came and he loosed that seal.

“Till the time of the end.” When did the time of the end begin? Not 1776; way before that. When Christ came and died he loosed the seven seals; the book was sealed, and when the seals were loosed, that was when Christ came and died on the cross for us. That’s when the end began: when Christ came on the earth and started teaching and died for our sins. That’s why he said, ‘repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand.’

“Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried”: many are going to be purified and made white in the time of the end, starting from when Christ came all the way till now. And many of us are going to be tried. Remember the class the Bishop touched on Saturday: the Most High is gonna try us to see if we believe or not. We are not just getting the kingdom; he’s gonna test us with persecution, and some of us he’s going to test even to our life, to see if we love our life.

“But the wicked shall do wickedly”: we have to understand the wicked gonna do wickedly. “And none of the wicked shall understand”: the wicked is not going to understand what this Bible is talking about. You could try to explain it to them as much as you want; they ain’t gonna get it. You can sit down there for weeks and months trying to show the wicked, and they’re not gonna see it.

“But the wise shall understand.” In the last days you’re gonna have wise men and wise women; they’re going to hear these scriptures and they will understand. That’s us today. You’re going to understand that you are an Israelite, you’re going to understand you got to keep God’s commandments, and you’re gonna do it.

That’s why I don’t go back and forth with people concerning scriptures. Our job is not to go back and forth with nobody; our job is to teach them. You brothers understand, all authority was given unto you by Christ to teach this word, to teach this Bible. None of us is to go back and forth with no Christian. We don’t debate, we teach. With some things I’m touching on today, the wicked is going to be like, yeah, he going off, that’s not what that means. But you brothers and sisters that are wise among us, you’re gonna be like, I see that, I understand, because you is one of them wise.

Now I’m going into the smoke of her torment. “In his last days shall the most High raise up three kingdoms”: his last days is talking about the fourth beast. In his last days the Lord is going to raise up three powerful Edomite kingdoms. “And renew many things therein”: they’re gonna be renewed. That’s what the Renaissance is about: they gained back their power. “And they shall have the dominion of the earth”: they gonna rule over the earth. This is talking about the eagle, the fourth beast, the white man.

“And of those that dwell therein”: they’re gonna rule over everybody that dwell on the earth, “with much oppression”. They gonna oppress everybody that’s on the earth. The white man didn’t just oppress the slaves. He oppressed China: remember the first and second opium wars. He oppressed the Arabs: you remember the Afghanistan war, and what they did in Iraq, the Iraqi war; they went over there and killed Saddam Hussein. You all saw what they did to Libya: the NATO forces went over there and killed Gaddafi. This fourth beast is going to oppress everyone.

“Above all those that were before them”: this oppression is also talking about him oppressing the children of Israel. The oppression we faced under the so-called white man was above the oppression we faced under the Persians and the Medes, above the oppression under the Babylonians and under the Assyrians. It is worse because he didn’t just take our land and our freedom; he took our language, he took our identity, he took everything. And when we mention it and say certain things, he calls us a hate group: you hateful, that was in the past, that wasn’t me, forget about it.

“Therefore are they called the heads of the eagle.” They are the three most powerful heads, and America is one of them. That’s why I went to America.

“For these are they that shall accomplish his wickedness”: those three heads are going to accomplish the wickedness on the earth, meaning the abomination and all the wickedness that the white man is supposed to do on the earth. “And that shall finish his last end”: they are going to be here till the end.

“For her sins have reached unto heaven”. Remember what we read in Ezra, that she shall fulfill her wickedness. Now we read here that the sins of America, of Babylon, have reached the heaven. All the wickedness America was supposed to accomplish, that the Most High God prophesied she will have to accomplish, she have accomplished. That’s what her sins reaching the heavens means: her sins are up there, they’ve been filled up, it’s fulfilled, and all the evil that she have been doing to us is going up to the Most High.

It also goes into us praying to our God and asking our God for deliverance from her, from the oppressor, and the Lord is going to hear our prayer and answer our prayer.

precepts.why:
“But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes”: God is talking to the wicked. Who is the wicked? The so-called white man, first and foremost. “Or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?” He has took God’s covenant and calls himself a Jew, saying they are the children of Israel, that they used to be under the old covenant. They were never under the old covenant.

“Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee”: the white man hates instruction, and he don’t listen to the word of God. “When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him”: he was just like them thieves. His mouthpiece is the media: the television, YouTube, the radio, books. “And thy tongue frameth deceit”: you are a damn liar. That’s who we’re talking about, the nation of Edom, the so-called white man.

“Thou sittest and speakest against thy brother”: his brother is Jacob, the 12 tribes of Israel. “Thou slanderest thine own mother’s son.”

“These things hast thou done, and I kept silence”: God kept silent while he was doing that. Remember, we’re touching on his sins reaching the heaven: God kept silence while this white man spoke much evil against us and did much evil to us. “Thou thoughtest that I was altogether such an one as thyself”: the white man taught that the Most High was evil just like him.

“But I will reprove thee”: that’s their sins reaching heaven; God says, I will reprove you. “And set them in order before thine eyes”: that’s what you see taking place right now. The 12 tribes of Israel is waking up, and we are being set in order before the eyes of the nation of Edom.

Understand that, Mr white man: you’re gonna pay for every last thing you did to the slaves. You’re gonna pay for taking this land from the North American Indians. You’re gonna pay for the lands you have taken from the so-called Mexicans. You’re gonna pay for enslaving and lynching and destroying the Negroes that you brought over here in the 1600s on cargo slave ships. You’re gonna pay for every last evil thing you did here on the earth. No sin go unpunished.

sense.text: “Concerning Edom, thus saith the Lord of hosts; Is wisdom no more in Teman?” Teman is supposed to be the wise of the Edomites, like the wise men amongst them, like these scientists. Is there no more wisdom? What happened to your technology? “Is counsel perished from the prudent? is their wisdom vanished?”

“Flee ye, turn back, dwell deep”: dwell deep means go into the ground and hide; go hide in your bunkers. “O inhabitants of Dedan”: I think that’s one of the cities in Edom. “For I will bring the calamity of Esau upon him”: God said, I’m going to bring the calamity of Esau upon him.

“The time that I will visit him”: the Lord is going to visit Edom. The Most High God, our King Christ, is going to visit Edom. Understand that, Mr white man: our King Christ is going to visit you all.

This is Christ coming to visit Edom. “Who is this that cometh from Edom, with dyed garments from Bozrah?” Bozrah is one of the capitals of Edom. “This that is glorious in his apparel, travelling in the greatness of his strength?” The greatness of his strength is all the angels with him. “I that speak in righteousness, mighty to save.”
“Wherefore art thou red in thine apparel, and thy garments like him that treadeth in the winefat?” This is Isaiah saying, why is your garment so dipped in blood?

“I have trodden the winepress alone”: who is the I here? The Lord Christ. Christ is going to go to Europe and he’s going to destroy; he’s gonna tread the winepress over there. Who is this coming from Bozrah? That’s where he’s coming from: he’s coming from all Europe. Christ is going to go over there and do a lot of killing.

“And of the people there was none with me”: Christ is going to say, listen, I don’t want none of you all to come with me, I gotta do this on my own; I don’t think you’re gonna be able to stand what I’m about to do.

“For I will tread them in mine anger”: the them here is the Europeans, Europe. “And trample them in my fury”. Why is Christ angry? Why is he so furious? Because of what they did to the children of Israel, his people, and what they are going to do to us in the near future. It could be five years from now, 10 years, 15 years, might be 20, but it’s not too far from now. When you watch the prophecy, we see Israel waking up, so we know what time we are in. The only thing we’re waiting on right now is for us to learn these laws and build ourselves up.

“And their blood shall be sprinkled upon my garments”: Christ said, listen, the blood is gonna be sprinkled on my garment. I’m going to Europe and I’m going to be doing a lot of killing; that’s where all this blood on my garment come from, me killing Europeans. Isaiah said, why is your garment so dipped in blood? And Christ said, listen, I went over there and I had to do some killing, and I did it alone. Christ will become a mass murderer on this earth: he’s going to destroy all the armies, and then he’s going to go over into Europe and kill millions and millions of people. “And I will stain all my raiment.”
“For the day of vengeance is in mine heart”. Y’all better understand what Bible you are reading. Don’t be in la la land saying, oh, that’s the Old Testament.

precepts.why:
I could go to the New Testament and show you all that too, because we got some Christians lurking. When I said Christ is going to kill the Europeans you all are thinking, this dude is racist and hateful; read Revelation 19.

“And he was clothed with a vesture dipped in blood: and his name is called The Word of God.” This man’s garment is gonna be dipped in blood, and his name is called the Word of God, so we know this is talking about Christ. “And the armies which were in heaven followed him upon white horses”: that’s all angels, “clothed in fine linen, white and clean.”

“And out of his mouth goeth a sharp sword, that with it he should smite the nations”: Christ is going to destroy the nations, nations like Greece, Turkey, Germany, Russia, Great Britain, Portugal. He ain’t coming to give the nations hugs and kisses. “And he shall rule them with a rod of iron: and he treadeth the winepress of the fierceness and wrath of Almighty God.” This is the same thing we read in Isaiah 63: for those of you all saying that’s the Old Testament, it’s revealing the same thing in the New Testament. “And he hath on his vesture and on his thigh a name written, KING OF KINGS, AND LORD OF LORDS.”

The multitude is all the armies, the armies from Europe and all the nations that are going to come to fight against Christ.

“And burned them up every one”: that is the day that shall burn as an oven and burn them up. An “innumerable multitude”, a multitude of people you can’t even count, and “nothing was to be perceived, but only dust and smell of smoke”. When Christ deals with the armies of the earth, that innumerable multitude that is going to try to roll on him, there ain’t gonna be nothing left but dust and smoke.

“For every battle of the warrior is with confused noise, and garments rolled in blood”: every battle of the warriors is like that, everybody getting bloody. “But this shall be with burning and fuel of fire.” That is Christ destroying all the armies of the earth. He gonna burn everybody up with burning and fuel of fire.

This battle is the battle in the valley of Jehoshaphat. There ain’t gonna be no noise for real, and his garment ain’t gonna get dipped in blood until he go over there in Bozrah.

sense.text:
This touches on Babylon being destroyed with fire the way Sodom and Gomorrah was destroyed. “Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the coals in the fire”: the Most High God said he created the smith that blows the coals in the fire. A smith is somebody that makes weapons, but the smith the Lord is talking about here is a scientist. He doesn’t make regular weapons, not swords and knives and axes; he makes weapons that destroy millions of people with one shot.

“And that bringeth forth an instrument for his work”: the instrument he brings forth is the nuclear bomb, the atom bomb, “for his work”, to kill millions of people. “And I have created the waster to destroy”: the waster is a nuclear weapon. The Bible calls a nuclear bomb a waster, created to destroy Babylon, to destroy America.

This prophecy was fulfilled in that scientist creating the atom bomb. The man who made it looked like the devil, and he is: one of the sons of Satan. He said he had become death, the destroyer of worlds. This is the dude that created the atom bomb that killed hundreds of thousands of people, the bomb they used to create the nuclear weapon. The scripture was fulfilled with him.

“Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day”. That arrow that flieth by day is not talking about a regular bow and arrow. It’s talking about intercontinental ballistic missiles, nuclear weapons. This is what the prophet saw, and they described it as arrows. We shall not be afraid of it.

“Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.” The destruction that wasteth goes back to the waster we read early on in Isaiah 54:16. The waster is talking about nuclear weapons.

How do we know that? “A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand”. What has the power to kill a thousand people on one side of you and ten thousand people at your right hand? This is talking about nuclear weapons, brothers and sisters; that’s what the waster is.

So when it says Babylon is going to be destroyed like Sodom and Gomorrah, understand it’s going into nuclear destruction. That’s how America will be destroyed: by thermonuclear destruction. Europe won’t be destroyed like that; the armies of the earth are going to be destroyed by Christ. But America will be destroyed by thermonuclear destruction. Thus saith the Lord.

Let’s read the prophecies concerning that; let’s get into the smoke of her torment. “Behold, a people shall come from the north”. Pull up a map of the land of Israel and go north: you got Turkey, Georgia, Russia, France, the Netherlands. All of that is the north. When it mentions the north it’s going into the European Union: Germany, France, Spain, Italy, Greece. It’s going into those ten horns.

“And a great nation, and many kings shall be raised up from the coasts of the earth”. The many kings are those ten kings we read about, those ten horns.

“They shall hold the bow and the lance”: they’re gonna get weapons of war. “They are cruel, and will not shew mercy”. “Their voice shall roar like the sea, and they shall ride upon horses, every one put in array, like a man to the battle, against thee, O daughter of Babylon.” So who are they coming for? The daughter of Babylon. And who is the daughter of Babylon? America.

precepts.why:
“The great and mighty clouds”: clouds, plural, meaning many. These clouds are NATO, the ten horns; that’s who these clouds are talking about. “Full of wrath”: they’re gonna be angry at America. “And the star, that they may make all the earth afraid, and them that dwell therein”: the star is that nuclear bomb, and everybody that dwells in the earth is gonna be afraid.

“And they shall pour out over every high and eminent place an horrible star”: a horrible star is a nuclear weapon. This is what Europe is gonna do, what the ten horns are gonna do, what them clouds are gonna do. Fire, “and flying swords”: that’s their weapons, ballistic missiles and all of that. This is what NATO is going to be doing; this is world war three. “And many waters, that all fields may be full, and all rivers, with the abundance of great waters”: they’re gonna be raining down missiles on many nations.

“And they shall break down the cities and walls, mountains and hills, trees of the wood, and grass of the meadows, and their corn.” That’s what they’re gonna do with their ballistic missiles. “And they shall go stedfastly unto Babylon, and make her afraid”: make America afraid. The Babylon here is America.

“They shall come to her, and besiege her”: surround her. “The star and all wrath shall they pour out upon her”: all wrath they’re gonna pour out on that hoe. “Then shall the dust and smoke go up unto the heaven”. So when America is destroyed you’re going to see the smoke going up to heaven.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast”: the ten horns are NATO, the European Union. They’re gonna hate America. “And shall make her desolate and naked”: they’re going to destroy America, and who is going to do that is NATO, the ten horns, the European Union. “And shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire.” What kind of fire? Nuclear fire; that’s the type of fire America will be destroyed with. Europe, where they at? The north. They’re also referred to as the north, and they will destroy America with thermonuclear destruction.

“For God hath put in their hearts”: God has put it in France, Spain, Germany, Poland, all of them, “to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.”

So when we read that America will be overthrown like Sodom and Gomorrah, it’s talking about that nuclear bomb, and who’s going to drop them nuclear bombs here in America is NATO, the European Union. America is the head of NATO, so NATO might be dissolved; they’re going to kick America out to the curb and set up their own military alliance, the EU’s own military. Then they’re gonna come against America, besiege America and destroy America. That is Bible prophecy, because thus the Lord has spoken it.

sense.text: “Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils”.

“The kings of the earth have committed fornication with her”: all the kings of the earth have committed fornication with America. “And the merchants of the earth are waxed rich through the abundance of her delicacies”: the nations are rich through America, through trading and selling.

“Come out of her, my people”: God tells us to come out from amongst America, “that ye be not partakers of her sins”, the sins here in America, “and that ye receive not of her plagues”, the plagues that are coming to America. And that plague is nuclear destruction.
“For her sins have reached unto heaven, and God hath remembered her iniquities.” “Double unto her double according to her works”: she’s gonna get double.

“How much she hath glorified herself, and lived deliciously, so much torment and sorrow give her: for she saith in her heart, I sit a queen, and am no widow, and shall see no sorrow.” This is what America thinks: everything will always be good; we got the most powerful military and nobody can invade us. That’s how America thinks. But the Lord says otherwise.

“Therefore shall her plagues come in one day”: in one day all them plagues are coming here to America, “death, and mourning, and famine; and she shall be utterly burned with fire”. What kind of fire? Nuclear fire. “For strong is the Lord God who judgeth her”. And who will the Lord use to judge her? NATO, the European Union, same thing: the European Union is the economic side and NATO is the military. America is part of NATO, but they’re going to kick America out soon.

“And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication and lived deliciously with her, shall bewail her, and lament for her, when they shall see the smoke of her burning”: when them bombs drop. The merchants out in the sea, them ships bringing in cargo, are gonna see America burning, New York City burning, California burning. “Standing afar off for the fear of her torment, saying, Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city!” That great city, America. “For in one hour is thy judgment come”: it’s gonna take NATO one hour to destroy all the cities in America.

What is her torment here, brothers? Nuclear fire. She is being tormented with thermonuclear destruction, and for the fear of her torment they stand afar off in the ships. America is destroyed, and the ships out in the sea see the smoke of her torment going up from the nuclear fallout when them nuclear weapons drop on America.

precepts.why: “And cried when they saw the smoke of her burning, saying, What city is like unto this great city!” When they saw the smoke of America burning, they were crying. There’s no other city greater than America. “And they cast dust on their heads, and cried, weeping and wailing, saying, Alas, alas, that great city, wherein were made rich all that had ships in the sea by reason of her costliness! for in one hour is she made desolate.” In one hour America will be made desolate, and who’s going to do this is Europe, those ten horns.

sense.text: “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies: he hath utterly destroyed them”. How is he going to destroy them? With supernatural power; as we read earlier, they’ll be left but dust and smoke. “He hath delivered them to the slaughter”: Christ is going to deliver them to the slaughter.
“Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases”.

“For it is the day of the Lord’s vengeance, and the year of recompences for the controversy of Zion.” Who does the land of Israel belong to? It belongs to the children of Israel. That’s the controversy of Zion.

“And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch.” In the spiritual realm you’re gonna have places that turn into pitch. This is not just talking about when them bombs hit; this is talking about something on a spiritual level.

“It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever: from generation to generation it shall lie waste”. The smoke is gonna go up forever and ever, and the place is gonna lie waste. Where is this talking about? America.

What we’re reading here is something taking place in the spiritual realm and the physical realm. After America is physically destroyed, something spiritual is going to take place here in America. After a nuclear bomb goes off, will the fire be quenched? Eventually the flames are going out, even if it takes five years; it’s really the fallout after the explosion that kills a lot of people. But this fire is not going to be quenched night nor day, which lets you know this fire is not the physical fire of a nuclear weapon in this realm. Something is taking place on a spiritual level that the eyes can’t see. (Those that watched the class from last year, A Thousand Years of Torment, will be picking up on this.)

“None shall pass through it for ever and ever”: America is going to lie waste. Nobody will be coming over here, nobody’s gonna be here.

“But the cormorant and the bittern shall possess it”: the cormorant is a bird, and the bittern is a bird too. If this place is burning with fire right through, would birds be able to live here? Hell no. “The owl also and the raven shall dwell in it”. If it was just fire burning, would the owl and the raven be here? So this scripture is going into two things: the physical and the spiritual. The birds dwelling here is the physical; the smoke that shall go up forever and the fire that ain’t gonna be quenched is the spiritual. And on the physical side, once America is destroyed, no man is gonna come back over here.

“And he shall stretch out upon it the line of confusion”: what does the word Babylon mean? Confusion. “And the stones of emptiness.”

“They shall call the nobles thereof to the kingdom”: where is Bush, where’s Joe Biden, Donald Trump, the senators, Elon Musk? They’re going to call the nobles thereof, “but none shall be there, and all her princes shall be nothing.” This is what’s going to happen to America.

“And thorns shall come up in her palaces”. When it said the fire is not going to be quenched, how would thorns grow with fire everywhere? So it’s going into two different things: the animals and the palaces full of thorns are the physical; the fire that’s not going to be quenched and the smoke that goes up forever are the spiritual. “Nettles and brambles in the fortresses thereof: and it shall be an habitation of dragons”: dragons are lizards. Like some Walking Dead type of stuff, with bushes growing everywhere in the cities. “And a court for owls.”

“The wild beasts of the desert shall also meet with the wild beasts of the island”. After the destruction in the physical realm, this is what’s gonna be taking place: America burnt up with fire, the place ruined, lizards running around, bushes growing everywhere, and nobody is gonna pass through America or live here again. “The screech owl also shall rest there”, “there shall the vultures also be gathered, every one with her mate.”
“Seek ye out of the book of the Lord, and read: no one of these shall fail”. What the Bible says is gonna come to pass; none of these things are gonna fail.
We read this all the time, but you all don’t pick up on it. “And after these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power; and the earth was lightened with his glory.”

“And he cried mightily with a strong voice, saying, Babylon the great is fallen”. Babylon the great is America. When the angel says this, America is already destroyed.

Remember Isaiah 34: something taking place on a physical realm and on a spiritual realm. Now let’s deal with the spiritual. After America is destroyed, America is gonna become “the habitation of devils”. What does the word habitation mean? A home, a dwelling place: a dwelling place of devils. “And the hold of every foul spirit”: what does the word hold mean? A prison, a jail for every foul spirit. “And a cage of every unclean and hateful bird”: remember Isaiah 34 said the owls are gonna be here. America becoming a cage of every hateful bird is the physical.

What I’m showing you is that America is where hell will be set up. This is where the torment is going to be taking place, after America is destroyed on the physical plane.

precepts.why:
“And the streams thereof shall be turned into pitch”: this is taking place in the spiritual. “And the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch”: it’s talking about the earth itself becoming burning pitch. We are talking about the Lake of Fire.

“It shall not be quenched night nor day”: this is when hell is gonna be set up. “The smoke thereof shall go up for ever”. So what we’re reading here, brothers, is on a spiritual level.

sense.text: “And I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven, having the everlasting gospel to preach unto them that dwell on the earth”. This angel is teaching the everlasting gospel to us that dwell on the earth, and that’s the time we’re in right now. “And to every nation, and kindred, and tongue, and people”: it says every nation because, remember what Bishop just proclaimed last night, we’re going international. We’re taking this gospel all over the world.

“Saying with a loud voice, Fear God, and give glory to him”: this is what is being taught to Israel, that has been scattered throughout the four corners of the earth. “For the hour of his judgment is come: and worship him that made heaven, and earth, and the sea”.

“And there followed another angel, saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city”. After that angel taught the gospel, another angel came right after. When the gospel is taught to the four corners of the earth, and we wake up and start keeping these commandments, this is what’s gonna happen: after Israel wakes up, America is going to be destroyed, “because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.”

“And the third angel followed them”: pay attention, this is after America is destroyed. “Saying with a loud voice, If any man worship the beast and his image, and receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”.

“The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture”: it don’t matter if you’re Chinese or Arab. “Into the cup of his indignation”: into the cup of his righteous anger. “And he shall be tormented”. This is going into the Lake of Fire. Why is it not nuclear fire? Because America is already destroyed. The angel is saying: if any one of you all that got burned up in that nuclear destruction had worshipped the beast and his image, you’re going to pay for that. What’s being set up now is hell, that torment, and it’s going to be in America; Isaiah 34, this place is going to be turned into pitch.

“With fire and brimstone”: that’s the brimstone we just read in Isaiah 34. “In the presence of the holy angels, and in the presence of the Lamb”: this shows you it’s not on a physical level but on a spiritual level. Who are they going to be tormented in the presence of? The angels and Christ. That’s who will be tormenting them; that’s who’s gonna cast them in the Lake of Fire.
“And the smoke of their torment ascendeth up for ever”: letting you know this is not talking about the physical; this is something taking place in the spirit realm.

precepts.why:
The smoke of them being tormented goes back to Isaiah 34. This is the memorial right here: the memorial for America is that the smoke of her torment is going to go up forever. America will become hell on earth.

“The streams thereof shall be turned into pitch, and the dust thereof into brimstone, and the land thereof shall become burning pitch”: this is talking about hell, where hell is gonna be set up here in America. “It shall not be quenched night nor day; the smoke thereof shall go up for ever”: that’s the same thing we read in Revelation 14.

sense.text:
“And the nations were angry, and thy wrath is come, and the time of the dead, that they should be judged”. Some say hell is not going to be set up: once you’re dead, that’s it, and nobody is going to be tormented. Everybody doesn’t have the same level of understanding in the scriptures, and as you grow and stay in this truth the Most High is going to take our understanding to another level. The water is going to rise.

“The time of the dead, that they should be judged.” You all think you’re going to live wicked and just die here in America in them nuclear bombs and that’s it. Nah. When you’re dead, that’s not it: after you’re dead you’re going to be judged. Before the second death, guess what has to happen first: being tormented in the Lake of Fire.

That is why the angel of Revelation 14 said if any man worship the beast and his image, he shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God. That’s them dead, and they are about to be judged. “Thy wrath is come” is that same wrath of God, poured out without mixture, that we read in Revelation 14. Christ is about to judge the dead, and that’s when hell is going to be set up.

“And that thou shouldest give reward unto thy servants”: unto the prophets. And the reward that is going to be given to the servants is everlasting life, as Daniel 12 shows; the others awake to shame and everlasting contempt.

You’re thinking that’s the end of it, that you’re going to be wicked and die and regenerate and come back righteous? Hell no. If you’re wicked, you die, you worship the beast and his image, you’re done: you’re going to be tormented in the Lake of Fire. Hell is real, but it is going to be set up when Christ returns. That is when the time of the dead, that they should be judged, takes place.

precepts.why:
You all think you escape: you get blown up by the nuclear bombs, you just go to sleep and that’s it. Nah, that’s just the beginning of it for all you adulterers, murderers, haters, brothers that don’t want to repent, sisters that don’t want to repent. “And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth”: when you’re dead you go to sleep. When Christ returns, if you’re wicked and dead you ain’t sleeping, and if you’re righteous you ain’t sleeping neither.

They “shall awake, some to everlasting life”: when they arise they wake up to everlasting life, meaning they are going to live forever. “And some to shame and everlasting contempt”: that goes back to the time of the dead, that they should be judged. Some will be awakened to shame and everlasting contempt, meaning your behind is about to be tormented, about to be cast in the Lake of Fire.

Remember what happened with Samuel, when the witch woke Samuel up. Samuel said, why have you disquieted me, why you wake me up? She woke him up in the spirit realm, and he was talking through her. That shows things in the spirit realm that we don’t fully understand.

Read with Revelation 11:18 again: the reward to the servants, the prophets, is everlasting life, and some are going to awake to shame and everlasting contempt. It is not talking about a physical realm for the wicked when it says they shall awake.

“And therefore be thou not curious how the ungodly shall be punished, and when: but enquire how the righteous shall be saved”. You think that’s the end of it when the wicked die; Ezra shows what comes after.

“Then shall they be in pitiful case, which now have abused my ways: and they that have cast them away despitefully”, that cast away the laws of God despitefully, “shall dwell in torments.” When the scripture says the time of the dead, that they should be judged, it is going into the torments: you being cast into the Lake of Fire, you being tormented.

“For such as in their life have received benefits, and have not known me; And they that have lothed my law, while they had yet liberty, and, when as yet place of repentance was open unto them, understood not, but despised it”: they despised God’s commandments while the place of repentance was open.

“The same must know it after death by pain.” So the time of the dead, that they should be judged, is not going into you just dying. You are going to learn God’s laws by pain after death.

“And I say unto you my friends, Be not afraid of them that kill the body”. Don’t be afraid, brothers, of no man that could only kill your body. That is what our Lord and our King told us: don’t fear nobody that could just kill you. When it comes to death, it is more than just your body dying. This body is just something to carry you, your spirit. Even when you die and leave this flesh, that’s not the end of it.

“And after that have no more that they can do”: they can’t do nothing else after they kill your body. Man can do that, but other things can be done to you after you leave this physical body, and guess who could hurt you after you leave this body: Christ.

“I will forewarn you”: I’m warning you before time “whom ye shall fear”. “Fear him, which after he hath killed hath power to cast into hell”. Christ is going to be killing people. He kills you, and after he kills your body he takes your spirit and casts it into that Lake of Fire, that torment, and that is going to be set up right here in America.

Christ says, don’t fear him that could just kill you in this body, but fear him that is going to kill you and after he kills you is going to torment you. Even if you’re dead and sleeping: wake up, time for you to feel some pain for all that evil you were doing. You’re going to feel pain after death; that’s what the scripture says in the time of the dead, that they should be judged.

“I am he that liveth, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore, Amen; and have the keys of hell and of death.” Christ said I am alive, for evermore. You all have to understand Christ has the keys of hell: he has the power to cast your evil black behind in hell, in the lake of burning fire.

Hell is real, but it is going to be set up when Christ returns. That is why it says the time of the dead, that they should be judged: that takes place when Christ returns.

sense.text: “For as the new heavens and the new earth, which I will make, shall remain before me, saith the Lord, so shall your seed and your name remain.” The new heaven and the new earth which the Lord shall make shall remain, and our seed and our name are going to remain.

“From one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith the Lord.” All flesh is going to come up to worship before God from one new moon to another and from one sabbath to another. This is in the Kingdom, in the new heavens and the new earth, and something else is going to be set up there too.

“And they shall go forth”: who is the “they”? Us. We are going to go forth “and look upon the carcases of the men that have transgressed against me”. How would we be able to look upon the people that transgress against God? Think about everything just gone over: Christ is going to set up hell here in America, and the wicked of our people are going to be tormented here in the presence of the angels and of Christ. So we are going to be able to see hell, the torment: we are going to look upon the carcasses of those brothers that are being tormented, the people that break God’s laws, like the rich man.

When you read about Lazarus, when the rich man said give me a little water: the rich man could see Lazarus, and he could see Abraham, Abraham’s bosom. And Abraham and Lazarus could see him.

“For their worm shall not die”: their worm is their spirit, and it shall not die. “Neither shall their fire be quenched”: the fire is not going to be quenched, because they are being tormented. “And they shall be an abhorring unto all flesh.” We’re going to look at it and be like, damn, I’m telling you, thank the Lord we kept the Commandments.

precepts.why:
“For in the resurrection they neither marry, nor are given in marriage, but are as the angels”. So in the Kingdom we are going to be like angels.

So in Revelation 14, when it says they shall be tormented in the presence of the holy angels and in the presence of the Lamb, who is that? That’s us, as the angels. That is how in Isaiah 66 we go forth and look upon the carcasses of the men that have transgressed against God.

“For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible”. Some things you can’t see in the physical realm unless you are an angel.

Remember Elisha: God opened eyes so that it could be seen there were more with him than with them, and he was able to see things in an invisible realm, the spiritual realm. There are things all around us in the spiritual realm we cannot see with these bodily eyes: demons, evil, angels. But when we are changed and we put on our spiritual body, we are going to be able to see things in the spiritual realm. That is how we will look upon those being tormented.

sense.text:
Back to Revelation 18: “After these things I saw another angel come down from heaven, having great power”, and he cried mightily with a strong voice, “saying, Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, and is become the habitation of devils”. Babylon the great is falling; America is falling. After Babylon has fallen, it becomes the habitation of devils. All devils are going to be here in America; this is where they are all going to be.

Who is going to be tormented and inhabit here in America? Devils, demons. That’s the Lake of Fire right there, man. They are all going to be in America, and they are going to be cast in the Lake of Fire by Christ and the angels.

“And the hold of every foul spirit”: you all know it says when the unclean spirits have left the man they go up and down. All them unclean spirits are going to be here, cast in the Lake of Fire. And every wicked brother and sister that never repents is going to be cast in the Lake of Fire and tormented. You ought to understand how serious this is. It’s not just, oh, I don’t keep the Commandments, when Christ returns he’s going to kill me and that’s it. No: you are going to feel pain after death.

precepts.why:
What does it mean by the habitation of devils? “There met him two possessed with devils, coming out of the tombs, exceeding fierce, so that no man might pass by that way. And, behold, they cried out, saying, What have we to do with thee, Jesus, thou Son of God? art thou come hither to torment us before the time?”

Before the time. That is saying there is a time that is set for the demons to get tormented by Christ. The demons said to Christ, have you come to torment us before our time?

And what will they be tormented with? With fire. Those demons and those unclean spirits and all of them things are going to be cast in the Lake of Fire. That’s why Revelation 18 says Babylon the great, America, is fallen and is become the habitation of devils.

When Christ touches down on this Earth, the Lake of Fire is going to be set up, and all demons and unclean spirits, every wicked unclean spirit, every wicked negro that ever walked this Earth and didn’t repent, are all going to be tormented here in a spiritual realm in America.

“When the evil spirit had smelled, he fled into the utmost parts of Egypt, and the angel bound him.” The demon fled into Egypt, and the angel bound him in Egypt. Understand this: all those demons you see running around all over the Earth are going to be in America, except for the spiritual demon Satan, who is going to be in Europe. All them unclean spirits and demons are going to be cast in the Lake of Fire here in America, and they are going to be tormented.

sense.text:
All Israel won’t be righteous until the wicked are taken out. “All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword”: there will be no more wicked Israelites on the Earth. All the sinners of God’s people are going to die, and after they die they are going to be cast in the Lake of Fire.

“Which say, The evil shall not overtake nor prevent us”: they say the evil is not going to overtake them or prevent them from being evil and living. When Christ returns all Israel is going to be righteous, every last Israelite.

precepts.why:
“Behold, I will send for many fishers, saith the Lord, and they shall fish them”. We are the fishers, and we are fishing our people today, the Israelites that are scattered throughout the four corners of the Earth.

“And after will I send for many hunters, and they shall hunt them”: we are going to hunt every last wicked Israelite that did not repent and is hiding, “from every mountain, and from every hill, and out of the holes of the rocks.” You could be hiding in them caves, in them bunkers; we are going to hunt you when Christ returns, so that all Israel is going to be righteous.

“Though they dig into hell”: even though our people dig into hell. Hell here is the ground: you build an underground bunker and dig into the ground. We are going to be able to sniff you out; we are going to know who the Israelites are. We are going to hunt every last one of you brothers and sisters that did not repent, even though you escaped them nuclear weapons, and you are going to die.

“Though they climb up to heaven, thence will I bring them down”: though you go into space, living in the space station, or go to Mars, we’re coming up there for you. You ain’t escaping; you can’t hide from us.

“And though they hide themselves in the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence”. “And though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea”: you go build something down in the sea, them underground hotels and all that survival stuff they got in the sea. “Thence will I command the serpent”: Leviathan is going to come for you, man. The Most High is going to send the Dragon for you. You can hide in the ocean, build something in the ocean and hide down there, but God says he is going to make sure every last one of the wicked of his people dies.

sense.text: “And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgment was given unto them”: “them” is the Israelites. “And I saw the souls of them that were beheaded for the witness of Jesus, and for the word of God, and which had not worshipped the beast”: which did not worship the white man, “neither his image, neither had received his mark upon their foreheads, or in their hands; and they lived and reigned with Christ a thousand years.” This is the righteous: the righteous are going to live and reign for a thousand years.

“But the rest of the dead lived not again until the thousand years were finished.” The rest of the dead are those brothers that are dead. Why do they not live again? Because they are in the Lake of Fire, being tormented, not coming back alive.

When the thousand years are finished, that’s when they come back: the Lord is going to bring them alive and then destroy their spirit, and they go out of existence. That’s when the great white throne comes down and the Most High calls all spirits; the nations, everybody, is about to get it, and there won’t be nobody left on this Earth but the Israelites, the 12 tribes of Israel. The wicked amongst our people are going to be judged by the things written in the books. That’s Judgment Day.

You ain’t coming back alive until it’s time. Some say you could live wickedly and then in the Kingdom regenerate as a child and be righteous. No: you are going to be tormented for a thousand years, you are not going to live again until the thousand years are accomplished, and after that your behind is going to be totally destroyed. Then every evil spirit, even death and hell, is destroyed, and there will be no such thing as hell no more. Hell is the torment that is going to be set up when Christ returns.
